what: pooled calibration, criterion choice, bar provenance and power for block 6 (loop-free preference arm Y vs R)
arm: Y = R with the cap reserved for edges no loop asserts; loop-asserted edges admitted only as backfill

doses_are_one_function.claim: the soft reorder (X) and the reserved cap (Y) select the same candidates whenever at least cap edges in the pool are not loop-asserted, which held on every cycle of every calibration seed
doses_are_one_function.evidence: the two calibration artifacts' per-seed effect, composition and displacement statistics are identical on all ten seeds, field for field
doses_are_one_function.consequence: the block runs one intervention arm (Y); X is not a second dose
doses_are_one_function.floor: the two arms would diverge only on a seed whose candidate pool holds fewer than 20 non-loop edges

criterion_choice.primary: paired mean difference in coverage, Y - R
criterion_choice.why_mean: the per-seed effect is 0 on half the calibration seeds and 0.027-0.063 on the rest, so median and sign criteria are near-blind at n=100 (power 0.03) while the mean is bounded (se 0.0021 at n=100)
criterion_choice.why_not_median: a median criterion would report the structural zeros as the effect and discard the large gains the mechanism predicts
criterion_choice.disclosure: the mean is sensitive to the tail; the artifact reports the median, the positive share and the per-seed rows beside it, and no criterion reads them

bar.provenance: one fifth of the R-over-C gain on block 5's 100 fresh seeds (mean 0.0485), read from docs/gate13_temporal_redundancy_block5.json; the intervention is meant to add to that gain, and 0.01 is a fifth of it rather than the smallest detectable effect

allocation_rule: first free 100-seed window after the calibration block, scanned over the tree plus the calibration seeds; an allocation may not contain a seed already written into the tree
null_check: at bar 0.01 with a true effect of zero the point criterion passes ~0% of the time by construction; the calibration therefore also reports the bar's distance from the calibrated mean in sd units below
caveat: ten seeds give a noisy sd and a noisy mean; the power table is an estimate from them, and the block reports its own observed mean and interval beside the bar either way
